spec.agency.evidence: [山岭巨人·codex] 规格0–1.5秒：我看到A冲来，立即沉下重心、双臂戒备，已在应对威胁；1.5–3.3秒：面对两次抓胸，我逐次用石前臂挡开，没有站着挨打；3.3–4.1秒：趁A第三次扬爪，我抓腰举起并立即上抛，反击动机和动作衔接成立；4.1–6秒：短暂追踪上抛方向后转看B、C及落点，没有长时间空等；7–11秒：扫视三具白骨确认战果，再放松双臂；11–13秒：威胁解除后恢复站姿合理。图1双手空着戒备、图2面朝冲击区域，与这些自身行为相容。；[食尸鬼·claude] Most of my beats make sense from my own side. In image 1 (0s), A runs on all fours, about 4 m out, snarling at the giant, and B and C charge side by side behind it with their eyes on him. At 1.5–3.3s A rears up and claws twice; after each block it raises a third swipe, and when grabbed at 3.3–3.8s it screams and struggles, so it never just stands there. B and C circle about 5 m out at 1.5–3.3s, waiting for an opening, and close in while A is in the air at 4.1–4.3s. That is pack behavior, not freezing or queuing up to die. At 4.6–6.0s, in image 2, B and C get hit head-on by the blast and rear back with arms flung up, and that reaction is in the script. The problem is A, the one that gets slammed into the ground. In image 2 (about 5s) A has already landed face down in the middle of the cracked ground, chest and face against the dirt. The script then says at 6.0–7.0s that 'A, B and C all fall straight backward onto their backs where they stand', and that A then lies on its back with its claws curled on its chest while its flesh rots away to bone. Lying face down, A cannot 'fall backward onto its back where it stands' unless it first gets up, and getting up after going down is banned in the negative prompt ('倒下后又站起'). The script never says how A goes from face down to face up. A's own last beat is unreachable, and the model will most likely make A get up or flip over, which breaks the ghoul death template.

At 0–1.5s all three of us stare at the giant and snarl; in image 1, A's skull face and both B's and C's faces point left at him. At 1.5–3.3s A stares at him while clawing, and B and C keep their eyes on him while circling. At 3.3–3.8s A still stares at him and screams after being lifted. At 4.1–4.3s B and C glance up once at A in the sky, then look back at him. During the blast at 4.6–6.0s, the script's 'body rears back' makes the head-back pose a forced reaction; image 2 shows B and C with heads thrown back and mouths open, which fits. keyframe.scale.evidence: [director·codex] 人物卡身高比为山岭巨人1.6米／食尸鬼1.8米≈0.89。图1中，巨人从头顶至脚底约占画面高度67%，A约占29%，后方B、C各约占20%–22%；巨人与A的投影高度比约2.3，未呈现规格要求的相近体型。角色存在纵深距离及姿态差异，不能直接用像素比换算真实身高，但附图无法确认透视校正后符合0.89的身高比，按拿不准即fail处理。文字中的“约1.6米”与人物卡一致；“只高半个头”缺少食尸鬼伏低时高度依据，不能据此确认比例合格。

spec.agency.evidence: [山岭巨人·codex] 按山岭巨人自身判断：图1双手空着、面向来敌，符合戒备起点；规格0–1.5秒我盯住A、下沉重心并微张双臂，已主动准备应敌；1.5–3.3秒两次横臂挡爪，挨打有即时应对；3.3–4.1秒趁第三爪扬起抓腰、举起并立即上抛，反击连续，没有举着空等；4.1–4.6秒短暂追踪上方后转看地面威胁与落点；7–11秒检查战果、放下双臂，11–13秒回到稳定站姿。戒备、防御、反击与收势的动机连贯。；[食尸鬼·claude] From my own position as a ghoul, every beat makes sense. In image 1 (first frame, 0s), A runs on all fours, mouth open and claws out, at the giant at the far left. B and C run in side by side about 8 m back, mouths open too. All three attack from the very first frame and nobody hangs back. Script 0–1.5s: A closes to about 1 m. 1.5–3.3s: A rears up and claws at his chest twice, at 1.7s and 2.5s, and goes for a third swipe at 3.3s. When grabbed, A shrieks and struggles. A is never idle and never just gets caught without a fight. B and C circle 5 m off and look for an opening. At 4.1–4.3s they are halfway through their leap while A is in the air. They don't freeze, wait in line, or walk slowly toward him. From 4.6s the shockwave hits them (a stated control state), and they fall backwards at 6–7s and die. In image 2 (peak, about 5s), A is driven face-down into the ground between B and C. B and C lean back with their arms flung up, which is a natural reaction to the hit. It is consistent with the script. Nothing in it makes us do something a ghoul wouldn't do.

spec.gaze.evidence: [山岭巨人·codex] 规格“视线”逐拍给出了我的目标：0–1.5秒看冲来的A，1.5–3.3秒挡爪时继续看A，3.3–3.8秒看手里的A；3.8–4.1秒抛出后抬头追踪飞出方向，约4.2秒低头看B、C，随后砸地后盯落点；7–11秒扫视三具白骨，11–13秒望向前方。4.1–4.3秒的仰头动作由“约4.2秒低头”补足转移时点，没有安排长时间脱离敌情的视线。；[食尸鬼·claude] Every beat that involves me has a written gaze, and the images match it. 0–1.5s: all three stare at him while charging. In image 1, A's skull face and open jaws point at the giant, and B's and C's heads also face left toward him. 1.5–3.3s: A stares at him while clawing, and B and C keep staring at him while circling. 3.3–4.1s: A keeps staring at him while lifted and struggling. Around 4.1–4.3s: B and C glance up at A in the air, then look back at him. The script excuses A's fall at 4.3–4.6s (thrown out of control) and B and C being hit at 4.6–6.0s (a stated control state). In image 2, A's face is buried in the ground, and B's and C's heads are thrown back by the impact, which matches being knocked back. From 6–7s on, after falling: 'they no longer look at anything', which the script states outright. No beat has a ghoul looking at the camera or wandering off with no reason.

spec.status_visual.evidence: [fidelity·claude] 按我对原版的记忆（附图里无法核实），DotA 1 6.83d 的 Toss 效果是：抓起附近一个单位扔向目标，落地时对 275 范围造成伤害，被扔的敌方单位多受 20% 伤害。它不附带眩晕、减速、沉默这类控制状态，所以原版也没有头顶旋涡之类的状态标记。规格从 0 到 13 秒的每一拍都没写控制状态，只有冲击、地裂和死亡。第4张峰值图里也没有画任何状态标记，B、C 只是被冲击波打得往后仰。负面词里的「眩晕漩涡」和「冲击波光环」排除的不是 Toss 的原版标记，所以不冲突。
